meta.title: Faro case study: custom software for an acceleration program
meta.description: How Axenor custom-designed and built Faro, the platform with diagnostics, strategy canvases, an AI advisor and mentoring for an 85-company acceleration program.

hero.title: Faro
hero.lead: The platform we custom-built for a business acceleration program.
hero.text: Like everything we do, Faro did not come out of a catalog: we designed it around one program's methodology, with its phases, its instruments and its roles. Today it runs in production with 85 companies.

challenge.title: The challenge
challenge.text: Dozens of companies, mentors and a program team working in parallel with sensitive data from each business. The program had to set a baseline, run intensive workshops, document every mentoring session and report at the close, without any company ever seeing another's data.

solution.title: The solution
solution.text: A platform designed from their methodology, with three workspaces: the company's, the mentor's and the program console. The diagnostic opens the journey, canvases save themselves, an AI advisor answers from each company's documents and minutes go through approval before they are published.

result.title: The result
result.text: The whole cohort works inside Faro: diagnostics, models, mentoring, schedule, attendance and surveys in one place, with official deliverables in one click and traceability for every step.

modules.title: Built piece by piece for the program
modules.subtitle: Each module answers a specific part of their methodology, not a generic template.

engineering.title: The engineering behind it
engineering.subtitle: Built to protect each company's data and to scale without surprises.

isolation.title: Isolation in the database
isolation.text: 121 row-level security policies. Separation between companies is enforced by the data engine, not the interface.

ai.title: AI inside the program's cloud
ai.text: Gemini on Vertex AI, in the same region as the rest of the infrastructure, with semantic search on pgvector.

scale.title: Automatic scaling
scale.text: Cloud Run containers that go from zero to ten instances on demand, with no servers to manage.

mobile.title: Ready for mobile
mobile.text: Installable as an app on Android and desktop, a native iPhone app and an offline screen in Spanish.

process.title: How we built it
process.subtitle: The same method we apply to every project.

understand.title: Understand the program
understand.text: We sat down with the team to understand their methodology, their instruments and who does what in each phase.

design.title: Design around it
design.text: We turned every phase, format and role into flows, permissions and screens, without forcing the program into a generic tool.

build.title: Build and launch
build.text: We delivered module by module, in the cloud, with data security solved at the foundation.

operate.title: Run and adjust
operate.text: We still own the platform: we run it, maintain it and adjust it to what the program needs.

capabilities.title: What Faro proves, applied to your challenge
capabilities.text: Faro solved one program's problem. Your challenge will be different, but the capabilities that made it possible are the same ones we bring to every custom project.
